# Ashes Server Lab

> Independent, unofficial, experimental open-source C++20 Ashes of Creation server-emulation / private-server research project. A local exploration sandbox and contributor starting point, not a complete MMORPG server. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Intrepid Studios.

## Capabilities and evidence

One local account and one locally connected player have been observed through launcher tether, lobby and world handshake; character initialization, possession, HUD, movement animation, basic movement/jumping, configurable speed and flight controls. Terrain is privately extracted from the user's matching archives: 2,669 Verra heightfields, including 82 rotated components, and one warped landscape mesh. Browser tools provide live terrain/player views, trails, packet/event inspection and SQLite logs.

Latest saved lab results, 2026-10-08: selected character name and health/mana/stamina bars verified from local-test values; all 31 loading readiness stages and input gates through native floor/collision and gameplay presentation; a roughly 12-metre W trial with zero corrections; automatic Winstead platform streaming plus 256 matching private collision tiles, with a roughly 36.18-metre grounded seam crossing and zero corrections. Stationary jump gravity was corrected to -1225 cm/s² with jump velocity 900 cm/s; the repeat had 55 acknowledgements, zero corrections and maximum disagreement about 0.00625 cm. Reviewed DLL automation handles login, Play and bounded movement tests in the configured workspace. These are separate historical controlled trials, not proof of full native parity or all routes.

## Limitations and contents

Very buggy AI-generated initial prototype followed by iterative debugging. Some walking jitter, moving-jump/air-control/slope parity, a period-key walk-toggle issue and initialization recovery remain. Live Shift sprint and stamina consumption are unverified; adapter Shift fixture success is not sprint proof. The client retains a 22-second loading-screen hold. Combat, NPCs, quests, abilities, inventory and progression are not implemented. Production multiplayer and public hosting are not validated; services bind to loopback. Complete prop, water and dynamic collision are not implemented. Default collision is base landscape terrain only; private Winstead platform data is excluded and not generated by standard setup. Live settlement tiers 0–6 and transitions are unfinished; maximum metadata is not a full city. Recordings predate the latest fixes. Gameplay development is paused as of 2026-10-08; the exported checkpoint has not been rebuilt/retested. Test results do not establish protocol completeness.

The repository does not include the client, game archives, extracted terrain, proprietary assets, a complete Unreal SDK dump, Epic EOS SDK or Oodle. Users supply their own matching installation and compatible Oodle library. Original lab code is MIT; third-party licenses and game-content ownership are separate. Initial setup downloads build dependencies and parser packages; completely disconnected setup has not been separately verified.

## Supported client and setup

Repository verification recorded on 2026-10-07: Windows x64, Steam App ID 4124950, Steam Build ID 21564631, executable AOC-CL-438018, Unreal Engine 5.6.0-438018, depot 4124951 / manifest 5983602515922551495. Executable SHA-256: 4f1cd43ceeb89190f048734efd4d63152b9f8e11fa31fc41093b0d90f4a1cd43. Setup and launch reject a different hash; newest Steam build is not a compatibility guarantee.

Requires Visual Studio 2022 C++/Windows SDK/CMake, MSYS2 MINGW64 dependency DLLs, Python 3.10+ with NumPy and .NET 10 SDK. Build source, prepare the user-owned client with the locally built EOS shim, generate terrain from the user's archives and launch locally. Follow the README's backup/restoration instructions.
